mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that reduces corporate borrowing costs and stimulates equity demand, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has been above 4.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which drives corporate earnings expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS have increased by at least 0.5% month-over-month for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to adopt an accommodative stance, leading to lower real interest rates and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 for two consecutive months signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate profit expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has been below 100.0 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below -0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates strong consumer spending, which drives corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS has increased for at least 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) indicates a 'higher for longer' monetary policy stance that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE has been below 4.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is above -0.02.
